headline: Nigeria's Wema Bank Reports 73% Profit Increase
summary: Lagos-based Wema Bank reported a 72.6% rise in nine-month profit to approximately US$63 million. The growth was attributed to higher interest and trading income.
why: Wema Bank is a significant lender in Nigeria, and its performance reflects the current interest rate environment in the country.

impacts.name: Wema Bank
impacts.why: Significant profit growth is a positive indicator for bank equity.
